definitions.explanation: The way a person carries themselves in speech and behavior, especially as perceived by others. Often used to describe an overall impression of someone's social deportment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{物腰|ものごし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
{物腰|ものごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I got the impression that he was a person with polite manners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な{物腰|ものごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I sensed a strong will behind the calm demeanor.

notes:
USAGE:
{物腰|ものごし} refers to the overall impression someone gives through their behavior, posture, and speech. It is almost always modified by an adjective: {物腰|ものごし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧ (gentle manner), {物腰|ものごし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ (polite bearing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物腰|ものごし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧ (gentle in manner)
- {物腰|ものごし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ (polite in bearing)
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な{物腰|ものごし} (calm demeanor)
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧な{物腰|ものごし} (refined bearing)
- {物腰|ものごし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a humble, unassuming person)
